rule: Every move has a positive quantity and different from/to
Every move is explained in one line
Stores only give stock they physically hold (not in-transit)
Warehouse never sends more than on hand + inbound due
No receiving store ends above its capacity (on hand + in transit + incoming)
Giving stores stay at or above minimum display per category
S++ flagships never give away their top-20 styles
No store-to-store move leaves the giver under 30 days of style cover
In-transit stock counted: never replenish a size already covered by stock + transit
No store both gives and receives the same SKU
Moves above Rs 1,00,000 at MRP are flagged for approval
